```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- use_module(library(readutil)).

main :-
    current_input(In),
    read_line_to_string(In, Line),
    split_string(Line, " ", " ", Parts),
    maplist(number_string, [M, N], Parts),
    unique_paths(M, N, Ans),
    format("~d~n", [Ans]).

unique_paths(1, _, 1) :- !.
unique_paths(_, 1, 1) :- !.
unique_paths(M, N, Ans) :-
    length(Dp, N),
    maplist(=(1), Dp),
    M1 is M - 1,
    iterate_rows(M1, N, Dp, Dp1),
    last(Dp1, Ans).

iterate_rows(0, _, Dp, Dp) :- !.
iterate_rows(R, N, Dp0, Dp) :-
    update_row(N, Dp0, Dp1),
    R1 is R - 1,
    iterate_rows(R1, N, Dp1, Dp).

update_row(N, Dp0, Dp) :-
    nth0(0, Dp0, H),
    update_rest(1, N, H, Dp0, Dp).

update_rest(J, N, Prev, Dp0, [Prev|Rest]) :-
    J < N, !,
    nth0(J, Dp0, V),
    NewV is Prev + V,
    J1 is J + 1,
    update_rest(J1, N, NewV, Dp0, Rest).
update_rest(_, _, Prev, _, [Prev]).
```
